title: StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning
title_zh: StateCraft：通过抽象状态推理增强视频世界模型

paragraphs.en: Video world models aim to simulate complex environments with realistic appearance and dynamics. Maintaining consistency over long interactions requires tracking past actions and understanding how those actions affect the environment. Video world models can only generate partial observations of the entire world at a time. Remembering past observations alone may not be sufficient in every scenario, as they may no longer reflect the world after a sequence of actions. We therefore introduce a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state. The abstract state keeps track of the entities’ changes as the world evolves, and is used to condition the visual state, which represents the current view. We propose StateCraft , a novel architecture that pairs a language model with a video diffusion model to evolve the dynamic world. We evaluate our approach on generative interfaces, which pose a substantial challenge because a single action may change parts of the state that are not currently visible. To support training and evaluation, we develop a data collection pipeline that produces informative, densely annotated trajectories at scale without human or agent supervision, together with a benchmark measuring generation quality, memory, and controllability. On this benchmark, our approach improves visual memory metrics by 0.30 (SSIM) and PSNR by up to 10 dB over the state-of-the-art baselines. We demonstrate that StateCraft maintains high self-consistency and strong generation quality over long trajectories. Because the abstract state is explicit, it can be edited directly, and generation follows edits to states never observed in the data. Finally, a proof-of-concept 3D experiment, in which actions change the illumination of an unobserved room, shows that the paradigm can also be applied to spatial environments. Dataset, code, and model weights will be made public: https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/ .

paragraphs.en: World models learn the dynamics of a system to predict state changes in response to actions. Recent advances have enabled the simulation of realistic 3D worlds ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2026 ) , robotics ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , driving scenes ( Russell et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) , games ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) , and, recently, graphical user interfaces (GUI) ( Rivard et al., 2025 ; Zhuge et al., 2026 ) . As world models generate only part of the world at a time, actions may lead to changes that are not directly visible, and consistent simulation requires understanding their effects on the world state and updating it accordingly. Current video world models represent this state visually, through frame histories ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Cai et al., 2025 ) , caches of encoded frames ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , reconstructed 3D point clouds ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , or recurrent states trained to reconstruct frames ( Savov et al., 2025b ) . Most of these memories store static content and cannot be updated by out-of-view dynamics. LiveWorld ( Duan et al., 2026 ) supports such dynamics only for the motion of recognized entities within a fixed 3D scaffolding.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型通过学习系统的动态过程，来预测在采取动作后状态的变化。 近期的进展使得模拟逼真的三维世界（Bruce 等人，2024；NVIDIA 等人，2026）、机器人系统（Yang 等人，2024）、驾驶场景（Russell 等人，2025；Gao 等人，2024）、游戏（Valevski 等人，2025；Qian 等人，2026），以及最近的图形用户界面（GUI）（Rivard 等人，2025；Zhuge 等人，2026）成为可能。 由于世界模型每次只生成世界的一部分，因此某些动作可能导致非直接可见的变化，而要保持模拟的一致性，就需要理解这些变化对世界状态的影响并相应地更新该状态。 当前的视频世界模型通过帧历史（Zhang 等人，2025a；Cai 等人，2025）、编码帧的缓存（Xiao 等人，2025；Chen 等人，2026）、重建的三维点云（Shen 等人，2026），或经过训练以重建帧的循环状态（Savov 等人，2025b）来以视觉形式表示这种状态。 这些记忆中的大多数存储的是静态内容，无法通过视野之外的动态变化进行更新。 LiveWorld（Duan 等人，2026）仅支持在固定三维框架内已识别实体的运动相关的此类动态变化。

paragraphs.en: The need for a more abstract and general state representation is especially notable in the field of generative software, where each frame is conditioned on a keyboard or mouse event to simulate a GUI. For example, deleting a directory’s contents empties the folder, yet the model should track that ’Trash’ now contains those files and display them when visited. Existing memory approaches mainly target 3D worlds, and those requiring camera poses or explicit geometry do not directly apply to GUI simulation. Moreover, observations alone do not fully describe the world state behind the scenes, making the simulation visually plausible but not functional in practice ( Rivard et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在生成式软件领域，对更抽象、更通用的状态表示的需求尤为突出，因为该领域的每一帧都依赖于键盘或鼠标事件来模拟图形用户界面（GUI）。 例如，删除目录中的内容会使文件夹变空，但模型应能追踪到“回收站”中现在包含了这些文件，并在访问时将其显示出来。 现有的记忆方法主要面向三维世界，而那些需要相机姿态或显式几何结构的方法并不直接适用于 GUI 模拟。 此外，仅凭观察结果无法完整描述幕后世界的状态，这使得模拟在视觉上看似合理，但在实际中却无法正常运行（Rivard 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: To model a more complete picture of the world state, we factorize it into an abstract state and a visual state. The abstract state is not tied to a specific representation. It is any structured record of the environment’s entities and their properties, including those out of view, that actions update directly. We develop StateCraft, which instantiates this state as a graph and complements a video world model with a VLM that updates and reasons over it. We demonstrate it on generative software, training the system to simulate a file explorer that preserves filesystem state and dynamics and supports editing them. We further propose trainable triggers on top of the video world model that decide when the VLM updates the abstract state, enabling programmable, event-driven interaction between the two. Unlike history-retrieval methods, our memory is dynamic rather than static. Unlike WorldDirector ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , trajectories are not planned in advance. Our VLM predicts state transitions online in response to incoming actions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建一个更完整的世界状态模型，我们将其分解为一个抽象状态和一个视觉状态。 抽象状态并不依赖于特定的表示形式。 它是对环境中实体及其属性（包括视野之外的实体）的任何结构化记录，而动作会直接更新这些记录。 我们开发了 StateCraft，它将这种状态实例化为一个图，并通过一个 VLM 来补充视频世界模型，该 VLM 能够对该图进行更新和推理。 我们在生成式软件上进行了演示，训练该系统模拟一个文件管理器，使其能够保留文件系统状态和动态变化，并支持对其进行编辑。 我们进一步在视频世界模型之上提出了可训练的触发机制，用于决定 VLM 何时更新抽象状态，从而实现两者之间可编程、事件驱动式的交互。 与历史检索方法不同，我们的记忆是动态的而非静态的。 与 WorldDirector（Wang et al., 2026）不同，轨迹并非预先规划。 我们的 VLM 能够在线预测状态转换，以响应传入的动作。

paragraphs.en: For training and evaluation, we develop a data collection framework for generative software. Existing pipelines combine a few goal-driven trajectories with many random, uninformative ones. Ours selects actions from interface elements and records aligned frames, actions, and structured state changes, producing informative, densely annotated trajectories at scale. We also release, to our knowledge, the first benchmark for video world models of graphical interfaces, evaluating generation quality, memory across controlled revisit horizons, and controllability under explicit state edits. On this benchmark, StateCraft keeps revisit self-consistency near 0.9 SSIM over up to 512 actions, while baselines remain at 0.5–0.6, and improves PSNR by up to 10 dB over the baselines. Direct edits to the abstract state are followed in 81% of cases, including hidden changes out of view, although inserting new elements on empty background remains difficult. A proof-of-concept 3D experiment shows that abstract state also guides generation beyond software interfaces. These results support modeling abstract state alongside visual dynamics as a basis for consistent, controllable simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了训练和评估，我们开发了一个用于生成式软件的数据收集框架。 现有的流程会将少数目标驱动轨迹与大量随机且无信息价值的轨迹结合。 我们的方法从界面元素中选择动作，并记录对齐的帧、动作和结构化状态变化，从而大规模生成信息丰富且标注密集的轨迹。 据我们所知，我们还发布了首个面向图形界面视频世界模型的基准测试，用于评估生成质量、在受控重访时间跨度内的记忆能力，以及在明确状态编辑下的可控性。 在该基准测试中，StateCraft 的重访自一致性即使在多达 512 个动作后仍能保持在 0.9 SSIM 附近，而基线模型则停留在 0.5–0.6；同时，其 PSNR 相比基线模型最高提升了 10 dB。 在 81% 的情况下，抽象状态的直接编辑都会被后续操作所遵循，包括视野之外的隐藏变化；不过，在空白背景上插入新元素仍然具有挑战性。 一个概念验证性的 3D 实验表明，抽象状态也能指导生成过程，超越软件界面的限制。 这些结果支持将抽象状态与视觉动态一同建模，作为实现一致且可控模拟的基础。

sents.en: A proof-of-concept 3D experiment shows that abstract state also guides generation beyond software interfaces.
sents.zh: 一个概念验证性的 3D 实验表明，抽象状态也能指导生成过程，超越软件界面的限制。

sents.en: These results support modeling abstract state alongside visual dynamics as a basis for consistent, controllable simulation.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持将抽象状态与视觉动态一同建模，作为实现一致且可控模拟的基础。

paragraphs.en: A novel paradigm that factorizes the world into a global, abstract state that tracks and reasons about structured changes of the environment, and a visual state that simulates what is in view at every instant, enabling long, consistent, and controllable interface simulation and extending to state-guided generation in 3D.
paragraphs.zh: 一种全新的范式：它将世界分解为一个全局抽象状态和一个视觉状态。其中，全局抽象状态负责追踪并推理环境的结构化变化；而视觉状态则模拟每一时刻的可见内容。这种范式实现了长期、一致且可控的界面模拟，并可扩展至由状态引导的三维生成。

paragraphs.en: StateCraft, a novel architecture that couples a language model and a video world model throughout ongoing interaction, jointly predicting abstract state transitions and visual observations as user actions arrive, and enables event-driven trajectory control.
paragraphs.zh: StateCraft 是一种新颖的架构，它将语言模型与视频世界模型在整个持续交互过程中耦合起来，随着用户动作的到来，共同预测抽象的状态转换和视觉观察结果，并支持事件驱动的轨迹控制。

paragraphs.en: A grounded data collection pipeline that records aligned frames, actions, and structured state changes, producing substantially more informative interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 一种基于实际数据的数据收集流程，可记录对齐的帧、动作和结构化状态变化，从而生成信息量显著更大的交互。

paragraphs.en: A novel benchmark for user-interface world models that isolates memory across controlled revisit intervals and evaluates state prediction, content reconstruction, and generation under explicit state edits. Our approach improves visual memory metrics (SSIM) by 0.30 and PSNR by up to 10 dB over the baselines on this benchmark.

paragraphs.en: Video World Models. Video world models simulate entire interactive 3D worlds via camera-/object-control ( NVIDIA et al., 2026 ; Team HY-World, 2026 ; Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Seo et al., 2026 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2024 ) , robotics simulators ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Quevedo et al., 2025 ) , driving environments ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Russell et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2023a ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Hassan et al., 2025 ) , games from user input ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Che et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; He et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2026 ; Savov et al., 2025a ) , while recent work extends this paradigm to desktop interfaces. ViMo ( Luo et al., 2025 ) addresses text corruption by separating textual and graphical generation through symbolic placeholders. NeuralOS ( Rivard et al., 2025 ) uses a recurrent latent state to condition diffusion-based desktop generation. Neural Computers ( Zhuge et al., 2026 ) further explores learned software execution, identifying symbolic consistency and long-horizon memory as open challenges. These approaches improve interface simulation but lack explicit mechanisms for maintaining entity identity and tracking off-screen state changes. We maintain structured entity states and update alongside the generation.

paragraphs.en: Memory-augmented world models. FramePack ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) compresses frame history, while Mixture of Contexts ( Cai et al., 2025 ) uses sparse attention routing for long-term retrieval. WorldMem ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) , HyDRA ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and VRAG ( Chen et al., 2025b ) retrieve historical visual information to preserve consistency. Spatial memory further supports consistent revisits: VMem ( Li et al., 2025 ) indexes past views through surfels, SPMem ( Wu et al., 2025 ) maintains geometry-grounded memory, Captain Safari ( Chou et al., 2026 ) retrieves pose-aligned world tokens, and Lyra 2.0 ( Shen et al., 2026 ) uses geometry to retrieve and align historical observations. Beyond scene recall, WorldDirector ( Wang et al., 2026 ) preserves dynamic entities through LLM-planned trajectories specified before generation, while LiveWorld ( Duan et al., 2026 ) simulates out-of-sight dynamics for selected entities, against a static 3D background. Our approach maintains an editable abstract state whose representation is not restricted to any specific environment.
paragraphs.zh: 增强记忆的世界模型。 FramePack（Zhang 等人，2025a）压缩帧历史，而 Mixture of Contexts（Cai 等人，2025）则利用稀疏注意力路由进行长期检索。 WorldMem（Xiao 等人，2025）、HyDRA（Chen 等人，2026）和 VRAG（Chen 等人，2025b）通过检索历史视觉信息来保持一致性。 空间记忆进一步支持一致的重复访问：VMem（Li 等人，2025）通过 surfel 索引过去的视角，SPMem（Wu 等人，2025）维护基于几何结构的记忆，Captain Safari（Chou 等人，2026）检索与姿态对齐的世界标记，而 Lyra 2.0（Shen 等人，2026）则利用几何结构来检索并对齐历史观察结果。 除了场景回忆之外，WorldDirector（Wang 等人，2026）通过生成前指定的、由 LLM 规划的轨迹来保留动态实体，而 LiveWorld（Duan 等人，2026）则在静态的三维背景上模拟选定实体的视线外动态变化。 我们的方法维护一个可编辑的抽象状态，其表示不受任何特定环境的限制。

paragraphs.en: Language and Vision-Language Models. Large language models support multi-step and compositional reasoning ( Wei et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023b ; Zhou et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023a ) , analogical inference ( Webb et al., 2023 ) , and representations of entity properties, relations, and spatiotemporal structure ( Li et al., 2021 ; Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ; Gurnee and Tegmark, 2024 ) . Multimodal pretraining and instruction tuning extend these models to visual inputs ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023a ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Dai et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . PaLM-E supports embodied reasoning ( Driess et al., 2023 ) , ReAct interleaves reasoning and interaction ( Yao et al., 2023b ) , and RAP predicts action outcomes for planning ( Hao et al., 2023 ) . Motivated by spatial reasoning in VLMs ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , we use one to predict updates to the abstract state.

paragraphs.en: In this section we first define the simulation problem and describe how StateCraft couples abstract-state prediction with video generation. We then present our data collection procedure and evaluation protocol for reconstruction, memory, and controllability.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们首先定义模拟问题，并描述 StateCraft 如何将抽象状态预测与视频生成相结合。 接着，我们将介绍我们的数据收集流程以及用于重建、记忆和可控性的评估方案。

sents.en: In this section we first define the simulation problem and describe how StateCraft couples abstract-state prediction with video generation.

paragraphs.en: We model the environment as a partially observable controlled process with latent state s t = ( G t , v t ) s_{t}=(G_{t},v_{t}) , comprising the full world state G t G_{t} and a pointer v t v_{t} to the focused node. The observation o t = Ω ⁡ ( s t ) = G t ​ [ v t ] o_{t}=\Omega(s_{t})=G_{t}[v_{t}] contains only that node, while actions advance the state near-deterministically, s t + 1 = T ⁡ ( s t , a t ) s_{t+1}=T(s_{t},a_{t}) . Transitions act on states rather than observations because actions can affect out-of-view elements. Frame generation follows x t ∼ R ⁡ ( o t , a t − 1 ) x_{t}\sim R(o_{t},a_{t-1}) . Since the full state s t s_{t} is not fully available in every environment, the simulator maintains an abstract state M t M_{t} distilled from observations and updates it through sparse state updates, M t + 1 = M t ⊕ Δ t M_{t+1}=M_{t}\oplus\Delta_{t} . M 0 M_{0} is the initial state representing the first observation alone. We keep the general structure but omit the rewards of the process, as our goal is simulation rather than planning.

paragraphs.en: We collect trajectories in GNOME Files on containerized Ubuntu with randomly generated filesystems. Instead of sampling inputs blindly ( Zhuge et al., 2026 ; Rivard et al., 2025 ) , our policy selects actions on interactable elements using the accessibility tree, which describes interface elements and their properties. The training set contains 1,956 trajectories and 586,210 actions, of which 47.7% lead to a visible change in the state. For evaluation, we collect 240 held-out trajectories of 300 actions. For memory, we construct 184 navigation sequences that enter a target folder, visit other folders, and return. Each is repeated at five revisit horizons, keeping target contents and revisit frames identical (920 trajectories). For controllability, we construct 293 clips from held-out trajectories by replacing element names or types, or inserting elements into the conditioning state and inpainting the result in the corresponding frame, while keeping the preceding visual context and action sequence unchanged. Using AT-SPI ( The GNOME Project, ) , we record aligned images, actions, and observations as τ = ( x 0 , o 0 , ( a t , x t , o t ) t = 1 L ) \tau=(x_{0},o_{0},(a_{t},x_{t},o_{t})_{t=1}^{L}) . Graph nodes represent views identified by folder path or dialog type, allowing repeated visits to reference the same node. We store the initial graph and subsequent changes, reset the environment between trajectories, and discard discontinuous recordings. Appendix A.2 provides terminology, collection details, and dataset splits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在容器化的 Ubuntu 系统上，通过 GNOME Files 收集具有随机生成文件系统的轨迹。 与盲目采样输入（Zhuge 等人，2026；Rivard 等人，2025）不同，我们的策略基于无障碍树选择可交互元素的操作，该树描述了界面元素及其属性。 训练集包含 1,956 条轨迹和 586,210 个操作，其中 47.7% 的操作会导致状态发生可见变化。 在评估阶段，我们收集了 240 条保留的轨迹，每条轨迹包含 300 个操作。 关于记忆能力，我们构建了 184 条导航序列，这些序列会进入目标文件夹、访问其他文件夹，然后返回。 每条序列都在五个重访时点上重复执行，同时保持目标内容和重访帧完全一致（共 920 条轨迹）。 关于可控性，我们通过替换元素名称或类型，或将元素插入条件状态并在对应帧中进行内容填充，同时保持前序视觉上下文和操作序列不变，从保留的轨迹中构建了 293 个片段。 借助 AT-SPI（The GNOME Project），我们记录对齐后的图像、操作和观察结果，表示为 τ = ( x 0 , o 0 , ( a t , x t , o t ) t = 1 L ) \tau=(x_{0},o_{0},(a_{t},x_{t},o_{t})_{t=1}^{L})。 图中的节点表示由文件夹路径或对话框类型唯一标识的视图，因此可以重复访问同一节点。 我们存储初始图及其后续变化，在轨迹之间重置环境，并丢弃不连续的记录。 附录 A.2 提供了术语说明、收集细节和数据集划分信息。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a protocol evaluating the state consistency required of UI world models. Full-frame PSNR and SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) can mask content errors because most pixels belong to static interface elements. Aggregate scores also overrepresent frequently visited views, such as home screens. We therefore compute crop-level metrics over state-bearing regions (path, main pane, and side list), using recorded element bounds and OCR-localized text boxes ( Du et al., 2020 ) , and weight frames by inverse frequency of the state and element appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种评估 UI 世界模型所需状态一致性的协议。 全帧 PSNR 和 SSIM（Wang 等人，2004）可能会掩盖内容错误，因为大多数像素属于静态界面元素。 综合得分也会高估频繁访问的视图，例如主屏幕。 因此，我们对包含状态的区域（路径、主面板和侧边列表）计算裁剪级指标，使用记录的元素边界和通过 OCR 定位的文本框（Du 等人，2020），并根据状态和元素出现的频率倒数对帧进行加权。

paragraphs.en: For commanded edits, the contrastive follow score indicates whether the prediction is closer to the post-edit than the pre-edit appearance over changed pixels. Let NEW and OLD denote these ground-truth appearances, and d new d_{\mathrm{new}} and d old d_{\mathrm{old}} their respective mean absolute distances from the prediction within the change mask ℳ \mathcal{M} . Then follow = [ d new < d old ] . \text{follow}=\mathbf{1}\!\left[\,d_{\mathrm{new}}<d_{\mathrm{old}}\,\right]. Reproducing the pre-edit state scores zero. paragraphs.en: We compare grounded collection with blind input sampling ( Rivard et al., 2025 ; Zhuge et al., 2026 ) , using regenerated NeuralOS-style data and a blind collector in our environment. Grounded collection produces three times as many transitions with substantial visual changes as blind collection in the same environment (63.9% versus 21.3%) and reaches deeper folders more frequently, while visiting approximately double the amount of unique state over 300 actions. These results support targeting interactable elements to collect informative training trajectories. Corpus descriptions, statistical analyses, and coverage estimates are provided in Appendix A.2.2 .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on 240 held-out file-manager trajectories of 300 actions each. To assess state evolution and retention without requiring models to guess arbitrary unseen filenames, we supply first-visit filenames to StateCraft as element hints and to CF++-based baselines through text prompts. NeuralOS receives the corresponding ground-truth frame to initialize its recurrent memory. No additional target information is supplied on revisits. Generation proceeds autoregressively between initialization events. All methods are scored at identical frame indices, excluding the indices corresponding to first visits of directories. Abstract-state conditioning improves both backbones across all metrics (Table 1 ). For CF++, it increases PSNR by 10.29 dB over the unconditioned model and comes within 0.45 dB of ground-truth conditioning. Gains are largest on the canvas: text-region SSIM reaches 0.85, compared with 0.16 for CF++ and 0.15 for NeuralOS (Table 2 ), indicating improved reconstruction of variable interface content. Figure 3 illustrates this over a rollout. Subsequent experiments use CF++, our best-performing backbone. Appendix A.3.2 reports DFoT reconstruction scores by screen region and within text boxes.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 184 matched trajectory families, each entering a deep target folder, traversing distractors, and returning after N ∈ { 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 , 512 } N\in\{32,64,128,256,512\} actions, yielding 920 trajectories. Target contents remain unchanged, and target-visit subsequences are pixel-identical across horizons (zero MSE), controlling appearance while varying rollout length. All models receive the same eight ground-truth context frames, including the first target observation, and generate two further target frames before distraction. Corresponding filenames are supplied to StateCraft as element hints consistent with the visual context and to CF++-based baselines through text prompts. No target content is supplied again on revisits. We score only the designated target using ROI-level SSIM between generated first-visit and revisited frames (Section 3.4 ). This revisit target SSIM measures self-consistency rather than correctness and complements the reconstruction metrics in Section 4.2 . Figure 4 shows that StateCraft maintains high revisit similarity across horizons and substantially outperforms the baselines. Appendix A.3.1 details initialization and pairing and reports target-revisit similarity to ground truth across the same horizons, measuring reconstruction correctness. We also evaluate training-free and finetuned adaptations of Mixture of Contexts ( Cai et al., 2025 ) , and an oracle-retrieval of past latents based on GT state identities unavailable at deployment. Both are based on CF++. Implementation and training details are in Appendices A.3.1.2 and A.3.1.3 .

paragraphs.en: Our architecture allows direct edits to persistent abstract state. We test whether generation follows these edits when they conflict with visual context, using 293 held-out clips (Section 3.3 ). We modify one or more canvas elements in the next frame’s conditioning, keeping visual context, actions, and other tokens unchanged. Edits include label and category substitutions, multi-element substitutions, and insertions, under ground-truth or self-generated context and when entering or revisiting a directory. The baseline uses frames generated by the same model without the intervention. Table 3 shows an overall edit-following rate of 81%, compared with 0% without intervention, reaching 98% for category changes upon re-entry but 48% for insertion. Edited-region PSNR improves from 17.6 to 27.62 dB, although control-region PSNR decreases from 37.7 to 23.88 dB. Thus, state edits guide generation beyond visual history, with limitations in inserting new elements and preserving unedited regions. Figure 11 in Appendix A.3.7 provides visual examples.

paragraphs.en: Evaluated independently, the finetuned state predictor achieves 0.86 node and 0.96 transition accuracy on held-out navigation, versus 0.48 and 0.52 for the few-shot base model, showing that lightweight finetuning learns state dynamics. For our model of choice, this comes at the cost of out-of-domain generality (Table 7 ). Ablations on DFoT and CF++ show complementary conditioning roles: removing graph tokens reduces canvas SSIM by 0.31 on average and revisit SSIM by over 0.20, while removing actions causes smaller reconstruction losses. For DFoT, path-only conditioning barely improves canvas or memory scores. paragraphs.en: Following work on probing internal world representations ( Li et al., 2023b ; Esmati et al., 2026 ) , we train small classifiers on frozen video-model activations, supervised by recorded ground-truth states, to detect changes and distinguish five transition types, including no change, backward navigation, forward navigation, window closure, and navigation to a nonadjacent folder. Binary and five-class probes achieve AUROC above 0.97 (Appendix A.3.5 ). After generating frame x t x_{t} , the gate combines cached activations with incoming action a t a_{t} to decide whether to invoke the language model. The updated or retained state conditions x t + 1 x_{t+1} , requiring no additional backbone pass. In closed-loop evaluation, the gate skips 40.8% of language-model calls with 91.2% skip purity, reducing PSNR by 0.57 dB and SSIM by 0.008. This enables reciprocal interaction where abstract state conditions visual generation, while visual features govern subsequent state updates.

paragraphs.en: As a proof of concept beyond interfaces, we test abstract-state conditioning in simulated 3D interiors ( Li et al., 2024 ) , where a switch controls an unobserved room’s illumination. Room category and illumination state condition the video model, isolating its ability to render off-screen action effects. Trained on 8,644 trajectories across 14 houses, our model achieves 0.864 illumination-classification AUC on 120 balanced episodes from two unseen houses, versus 0.542 for separately trained CF++ without state conditioning. With visual context and noise fixed, flipping the illumination token shifts mean brightness by 63.7% of the ground-truth difference ( p = 0.0006 p=0.0006 across seven scene groups; Figure 5 ). These results support state-conditioned generation beyond interfaces, including unobserved action effects. Appendix A.3.6 provides experimental details.
paragraphs.zh: 为了证明这种能力不仅限于界面，我们在模拟的三维室内环境中测试了抽象状态条件化（Li et al., 2024），其中开关控制着一个未观察到的房间的照明。 房间类别和照明状态对视频模型施加条件，从而分离出模型渲染屏幕外动作效果的能力。 我们的模型在14栋房屋中的8,644条轨迹上进行训练，在来自两栋未见房屋的120个平衡集上实现了0.864的照明分类AUC，而单独训练的、未进行状态条件化的CF++仅为0.542。 在视觉上下文和噪声固定的情况下，翻转照明标记会使平均亮度发生63.7%的真实值差异的变化（七个场景组中 p = 0.0006；图5）。 这些结果支持了超越界面的状态条件化生成，包括对未观察到的动作效果的生成。 附录A.3.6提供了实验细节。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a paradigm that decouples abstract-state reasoning from visual generation. StateCraft pairs a language model that updates persistent state with a video diffusion model that renders it. Our benchmark demonstrates how abstract-state reasoning supports visual quality, long-term consistency, and controllability in generative interfaces. A 3D proof of concept extends state-conditioned generation to spatial environments. These results support explicit, evolving memory as a foundation for consistent and controllable world models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种将抽象状态推理与视觉生成解耦的范式。 StateCraft 将能够更新持久状态的语言模型与能够渲染该状态的视频扩散模型相结合。 我们的基准测试表明，抽象状态推理如何支持生成式接口中的视觉质量、长期一致性和可控性。 一个三维概念验证将基于状态的条件生成扩展到了空间环境。 这些结果支持将显式且不断演化的记忆视为构建一致且可控制的世界模型的基础。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Our approach relies on a predefined state schema for each environment. Learning the schema and acquiring new content autonomously remain future work. Broader evaluation is needed across applications, changing environments, and 3D settings with learned state prediction. Improving robustness to accumulated state errors and establishing end-to-end latency gains are further directions.

paragraphs.en: The pixel-space denoising network is a residual U-ViT after Simple Diffusion [ Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ] : a 2 × 2 2\times 2 convolution patchifies each frame, which passes through a four-level hierarchy whose channel width climbs from 128 to 1024. The two finest resolutions use convolutional residual blocks; the two coarsest use transformer blocks, three per path at the intermediate level and sixteen at the bottleneck, with a single residual skip at each resolution. At a given resolution the tokens of all 32 frames of a training clip form one joint sequence, on the order of twenty-five thousand tokens at the intermediate level and six thousand at the bottleneck. Each block runs attention and feed-forward in parallel with query-key normalisation, and initialises every output projection to zero. Per-frame conditioning (noise-level embedding plus action embedding) reaches every block through feature-wise scale-and-shift modulation [ Perez et al., 2017 ] . The network totals roughly 364M parameters: 288M in the action-conditioned base model, 76M in the cross-attention modules added for graph conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 像素空间去噪网络是一个残差 U-ViT，基于 Simple Diffusion [ Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ]：一个 2×2 的卷积层将每一帧划分为 2×2 的块，这些块随后通过一个四层级的结构，其通道宽度从 128 逐渐增加到 1024。 两个最高分辨率使用卷积残差块；两个最低分辨率使用变换器块，中间层级每条路径包含三个块，瓶颈处包含十六个块，每个分辨率仅有一个残差跳跃连接。 在给定分辨率下，训练片段中所有 32 帧的标记构成一个联合序列，在中间层级约有二万五千个标记，在瓶颈处则有六千个标记。 每个块并行执行注意力和前馈操作，并采用查询-键归一化，同时将所有输出投影初始化为零。 每帧的条件信息（噪声水平嵌入加动作嵌入）通过特征级的缩放与偏移调制 [ Perez et al., 2017 ] 传递到每个块中。 该网络总共有约 3.64 亿个参数：其中 2.88 亿个来自动作条件化的基础模型，7600 万个来自为图条件化添加的交叉注意力模块。

paragraphs.en: The causal-forcing backbone (CF++) starts from the Wan2.1-1.3B diffusion transformer [ Team Wan et al., 2025 ] and its VAE, finetuned under the causal forcing recipe [ Zhu et al., 2026 , Zhao et al., 2026 ] so that generation is frame-autoregressive: each frame is denoised in 2 steps conditioned only on past frames, at 640 × 480 640\times 480 . Action and graph conditioning enter both through cross-attention, following the ideas presented in Zhuge et al. [2026] , with output projections zero-initialized so the pretrained model is undisturbed at insertion. This version has a total of 1.89B parameters: 1.42B in the Wan2.1 backbone and 470M in the added conditioning cross-attention layers. Actions use the encoding described below, projected to cross-attention tokens. Because the model denoises in latent space, the per-pixel weight map of Equation 3 is projected onto the latent grid at the VAE’s downsampling factor.
paragraphs.zh: 因果强制主干网络（CF++）基于 Wan2.1-1.3B 扩散变换器 [Team Wan et al., 2025] 及其 VAE，并在因果强制方案 [Zhu et al., 2026, Zhao et al., 2026] 下进行了微调，以实现帧自回归生成：每一帧在 640 × 480 640\times 480 的分辨率下，仅根据历史帧通过 2 步去噪处理。动作和图条件信息均通过交叉注意力机制输入，遵循 Zhuge et al. paragraphs.en: CF++ adapts Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B to frame-by-frame generation with the causal forcing recipe [ Zhu et al., 2026 , Zhao et al., 2026 ] . Starting from the public weights, we warm up the graph cross-attention for 30k steps, train the causal diffusion stage for 39k steps, and evaluate the final consistency-distillation stage, where we apply the latent-projected weight map. The VAE encodes each frame separately, so actions and graph tokens align one-to-one with latent frames, with frame t + 1 t{+}1 receiving the transition of frame t t . We train on 21-frame clips; at inference, each frame is generated in 2 denoising steps with a key-value cache of up to 21 previous frames, after 8 ground-truth frames. Wan’s text input receives the ground-truth path and first-visit filenames of each folder for the CF++ baselines (Section 4.2 ), and the fixed prompt "desktop file manager UI transition" for StateCraft.
paragraphs.zh: CF++ 采用因果强制方法 [Zhu et al., 2026, Zhao et al., 2026]，将 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 适配为逐帧生成模型。 从公开权重开始，我们对图交叉注意力进行 30k 步预热，训练因果扩散阶段 39k 步，并评估最终的连贯性蒸馏阶段，其中应用了潜在空间投影的权重映射。 VAE 对每一帧分别编码，因此动作和图令牌与潜在帧一一对应，其中第 t+1 帧接收第 t 帧的过渡信息。 我们在包含 21 帧的视频片段上进行训练；在推理阶段，每个帧经过 8 个真实帧后，通过最多包含 21 个先前帧的关键值缓存，在 2 次去噪步骤中生成。 Wan 的文本输入接收 CF++ 基线方法（第 4.2 节）中各文件夹的真实路径和首次访问文件名，以及 StateCraft 使用的固定提示“桌面文件管理器 UI 过渡”。

paragraphs.en: The interaction verb, one of six classes spanning single, double, and right clicks, menu activations, window-management operations, and the null action, is a learnable embedding. Click coordinates, normalized to the unit square, are polar-decomposed, lifted onto the unit three-sphere, and unrolled into sinusoidal features at logarithmically spaced frequencies, giving a positional encoding that varies smoothly across the screen; verb and position encodings are concatenated and projected to the width of the modulation pathway.
paragraphs.zh: 交互动词是六种类别之一，涵盖单击、双击和右键单击、菜单激活、窗口管理操作以及空操作，它是一种可学习的嵌入表示。 点击坐标被归一化到单位正方形，然后进行极坐标分解，映射到单位三维球面，并展开为在对数间隔频率下的正弦特征，从而生成在整个屏幕上平滑变化的位置编码；动词编码和位置编码被拼接后投影到调制通道的宽度上。

paragraphs.en: For DFoT, the action-conditioned base model trains first, alone. The cross-attention modules are then inserted and trained with the rest of the network frozen, their zero initialization leaving the base behavior intact; this warm-up shields the pretrained dynamics from the gradient noise of fresh modules and lets the attention patterns onto the graph tokens take shape before the backbone co-adapts. The whole network is then finetuned jointly. An exponential moving average of the weights is kept throughout and used for every reported result. Training runs to 110k iterations (roughly 400 H200 GPU hours). CF++ follows the same staged schedule, starting from pretrained Wan2.1: 40k iterations of initial finetuning, 30k iterations of warm-up and 39k of joint finetuning plus a final 1k of consistency distillation(roughly 400 H200 GPU hours). Conditioning variants (described in Appendix A.3.4 ) follow a budget-matched protocol: all start from the same action-conditioned checkpoint at 40k iterations, graph-conditioned variants are finetuned a further 70k iterations (30k conditioning warm-up, 40k joint finetuning), and the unconditioned baseline trains for the same added budget, so no variant sees more updates than another. The second stage enables the region-of-interest reweighting of Equation 3 for all variants.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 DFoT，首先单独训练动作条件化的基础模型。 接着插入交叉注意力模块，并在冻结其余网络结构的情况下进行训练；其零初始化保留了基础模型的行为特征。这种预热过程可防止预训练的动力学特性受到新模块梯度噪声的影响，并使注意力模式在图令牌上初步形成，之后主干网络才开始协同适应。 随后对整个网络进行联合微调。 在整个训练过程中持续维护权重的指数移动平均，并将其用于所有报告的结果中。 训练持续至 110,000 次迭代（约 400 H200 GPU 小时）。 CF++ 遵循相同的分阶段计划，从预训练的 Wan2.1 开始：初始微调 40,000 次迭代、预热 30,000 次迭代、联合微调 39,000 次迭代，以及最后的 1,000 次一致性蒸馏（约 400 H200 GPU 小时）。 条件化变体（见附录 A.3.4）遵循预算匹配协议：所有变体均从第 40,000 次迭代时相同的动作条件化检查点开始；图条件化变体再微调 70,000 次迭代（其中 30,000 次为条件化预热，40,000 次为联合微调）；无条件基线模型则以相同追加预算进行训练，因此没有任何一种变体的更新次数超过其他变体。 第二阶段允许所有变体应用公式 3 中的感兴趣区域重新加权机制。

paragraphs.en: We use Qwen3.5-0.8B [ Qwen Team, 2026 ] , adapted through low-rank finetuning [ Hu et al., 2021 ] on recorded state transitions. We use LoRA with rank 16, applied to all attention and MLP projections (q, k, v, o, gate, up, down). We train with an effective batch of 32 (8 on a single H200 × \times 4 accumulation steps) at 16384 max sequence length, learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , decay at 0.01, for 12k steps of which 100 are warmup. We select the checkpoint with the best structural validation composite, evaluated every 200 steps on a fixed 1,024-example held-out slice, and stop when neither that composite nor validation loss improves for 10 consecutive evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3.5-0.8B [ Qwen Team, 2026 ]，并通过在记录的状态转换上进行低秩微调 [ Hu et al., 2021 ] 进行适配。 我们使用秩为 16 的 LoRA，并将其应用于所有注意力机制和 MLP 投影（q、k、v、o、gate、up、down）。 我们以有效批量大小为 32（单个 H200 上执行 8 次 × 4 次累积步骤）进行训练，最大序列长度为 16384，学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁴，在 10000 步后开始衰减，总训练步数为 12000 步，其中前 100 步为预热阶段。 我们选择结构验证综合指标最佳的检查点，该指标每 200 步在固定的 1024 个示例的保留集上进行评估；当该综合指标和验证损失在连续 10 次评估中均未改善时，训练即停止。

sents.en: We train with an effective batch of 32 (8 on a single H200 × \times 4 accumulation steps) at 16384 max sequence length, learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , decay at 0.01, for 12k steps of which 100 are warmup.

sents.en: We select the checkpoint with the best structural validation composite, evaluated every 200 steps on a fixed 1,024-example held-out slice, and stop when neither that composite nor validation loss improves for 10 consecutive evaluations.
sents.zh: 我们选择结构验证综合指标最佳的检查点，该指标每 200 步在固定的 1024 个示例的保留集上进行评估；当该综合指标和验证损失在连续 10 次评估中均未改善时，训练即停止。

paragraphs.en: Inputs are kept from leaking answers: internal node identifiers and oracle transition labels are removed, and the identity of the clicked element is not handed over but re-derived from the click coordinates against the current node’s component geometry, so that the model must ground the action spatially just as its downstream consumer does.
paragraphs.zh: 输入内容不会泄露答案：内部节点标识符和神谕转换标签会被移除，点击元素的身份也不会被直接传递，而是通过根据当前节点的组件几何形状与点击坐标重新推导得出，因此模型必须像其下游消费者一样，在空间上对动作进行定位。

paragraphs.en: Finetuning minimizes the next-token cross-entropy on the completion alone, with two adjustments. First, the loss is reweighted across output sections, leaning on the transition decision and the predicted paths over the long tail of component text, and supervision on rarely seen filename tokens is stochastically down-weighted; without this the model memorizes the training name distribution instead of learning the shape of the transition. Second, model selection rests not on the scalar validation loss, which the memorization failure mode can drive down even as the useful capability degrades, but on a structural score that multiplies the rate of well-formed outputs by per-field quality measures, path correctness, component-kind agreement, and bounding-box placement, kept deliberately blind to the exact filename. Training examples are rebalanced across transition types, holding on to every state-changing and revisit step while thinning the uneventful ones.
paragraphs.zh: 微调仅针对补全部分的下一个词元进行交叉熵最小化，并包含两项调整。 首先，损失函数会按输出部分重新加权，依据转换决策以及对长尾组件文本的预测路径；同时，对罕见文件名词元的监督会被随机降权。若不这样做，模型就会记住训练集中的名称分布，而非学习转换的结构。 其次，模型的选择并非基于标量验证损失——因为即使模型出现记忆错误，这种损失仍可能被压低，而实际有用能力却在下降——而是基于一个结构评分：该评分将有效输出的生成率与各领域质量指标、路径正确性、组件类型一致性以及边界框定位相乘，并刻意忽略具体的文件名。 训练样本会按转换类型重新平衡，保留所有状态变化和重访步骤，同时减少无事件发生的样本比例。

paragraphs.en: During training, the memory retrieval that surfaces revisited nodes comes from an oracle on half the trajectories and from the same rule-based address resolution used at inference on the other half, so the model never trains on a retrieval distribution it will not meet once deployed. At inference it decodes greedily. We explored the option of having the model operate under a grammar constraint that limits generation to the legal completion shapes and to reference paths actually present in the prompt, but we found it overall detrimental to performance compared to letting the model generate freely.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练过程中，浮现出重复访问节点的记忆检索机制有一半轨迹来自一个预言机，而另一半则采用与推理阶段相同的基于规则的地址解析方式，因此模型从未在部署后无法应对的检索分布上进行训练。 在推理阶段，它会进行贪心解码。 我们探索了让模型在语法约束下运行的可能性，这种约束将生成限制为合法的完成形态以及提示中实际存在的引用路径，但我们发现，与允许模型自由生成相比，这种方式总体上对性能有害。

paragraphs.en: An accessibility tree describes interface elements through their roles, labels, and screen bounds; AT-SPI provides access to this information. In the file manager, the breadcrumb displays the current path, the main pane displays folder contents, and the sidebar provides navigation shortcuts. Our state graph records views as nodes and individual elements as their components.
paragraphs.zh: 可访问性树通过角色、标签和屏幕边界来描述界面元素；AT-SPI 提供了对此信息的访问权限。 在文件管理器中，面包屑显示当前路径，主面板显示文件夹内容，而侧边栏则提供导航快捷方式。 我们的状态图将视图记录为节点，并将单个元素记录为其组件。

paragraphs.en: Each session runs in a disposable Ubuntu container with a virtual display, session bus, and accessibility bus. Its seed determines a synthetic filesystem with 12–24 top-level directories, subtrees of varying depth, and valid files of different media types. The policy selects interactable elements from the accessibility tree. Each step records a cursor-free screenshot, absolute cursor coordinates, the target component, the interaction verb, and structured state changes.
paragraphs.zh: 每个会话都在一个一次性 Ubuntu 容器中运行，该容器包含虚拟显示器、会话总线和无障碍总线。 其种子会确定一个合成文件系统，该系统包含 12–24 个顶层目录、不同深度的子树以及不同媒体类型的有效文件。 策略从无障碍树中选择可交互的元素。 每个步骤都会记录一张无光标的截图、绝对光标坐标、目标组件、交互动词以及结构化的状态变化。

sents.zh: 每个会话都在一个一次性 Ubuntu 容器中运行，该容器包含虚拟显示器、会话总线和无障碍总线。

sents.en: Its seed determines a synthetic filesystem with 12–24 top-level directories, subtrees of varying depth, and valid files of different media types.

sents.en: The policy selects interactable elements from the accessibility tree.
sents.zh: 策略从无障碍树中选择可交互的元素。

sents.en: Each step records a cursor-free screenshot, absolute cursor coordinates, the target component, the interaction verb, and structured state changes.
sents.zh: 每个步骤都会记录一张无光标的截图、绝对光标坐标、目标组件、交互动词以及结构化的状态变化。

paragraphs.en: The window system identifies the active window and its geometry, while the application identifies the displayed directory. Path recovery uses, in order, the application-reported location, the navigation breadcrumb, and matching between visible labels and filesystem contents. Disagreement lowers confidence and emits a warning without replacing measured values with heuristic estimates. Consecutive post- and pre-states use the same source and settling point. Views are identified by folder path or dialog type; closed transient overlays become placeholder handles, composite icon-label rows become single elements, and decorative widgets are removed. We store the initial graph, subsequent updates, and element bounds for loss weighting and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 窗口系统识别当前激活的窗口及其几何形状，而应用程序则识别所显示的目录。 路径恢复依次使用应用程序报告的位置、导航面包屑，以及可见标签与文件系统内容之间的匹配关系。 不一致性会降低置信度并触发警告，但不会用启发式估计值替换测量值。 连续的后继状态和先前状态使用相同的源和稳定点。 视图通过文件夹路径或对话框类型进行识别；已关闭的临时覆盖层变为占位符句柄，组合图标-标签行变为单个元素，装饰性小工具则被移除。 我们存储初始图、后续更新以及元素边界，用于损失加权与评估。

paragraphs.en: The collector distinguishes principal windows, transient overlays, popup menus, and foreign windows. When collection stalls, it applies a bounded sequence of dismissal actions, each recorded as a transition. Before each trajectory, it restores the filesystem snapshot and resets windows, history, bookmarks, and geometry. Parallel sessions record their seeds and configurations. Validation checks state continuity, overlay loops, stale target geometry, and missing frames; trajectories with fatal defects are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 收集器能够区分主窗口、临时覆盖层、弹出菜单和外部窗口。 当收集过程停滞时，它会执行一系列有界的操作以关闭窗口，每一步操作都会被记录为一个状态转换。 在每条轨迹开始前，它会恢复文件系统快照，并重置窗口、历史记录、书签和几何布局。 并行会话会记录各自的种子数据和配置信息。 验证过程会检查状态连续性、覆盖层循环、过时的目标几何布局以及缺失的帧；存在致命缺陷的轨迹将被排除。

sents.zh: 收集器能够区分主窗口、临时覆盖层、弹出菜单和外部窗口。

paragraphs.en: Section 4.1 compares three collection settings:
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.1 节比较了三种收集设置：

paragraphs.en: Grounded: 1,956 training trajectories containing 586,210 actions, with screenshots, target identities, semantic outcomes, and graph updates. A separate corpus contains 240 trajectories and 72,000 actions and provides an additional coverage estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 基础数据：包含 586,210 个动作的 1,956 条训练轨迹，附带截图、目标身份、语义结果和图更新。 另一个独立语料库包含 240 条轨迹和 72,000 个动作，并提供了额外的覆盖范围估算。

paragraphs.en: NeuralOS-style: because the original data was unavailable, we run the published collector unmodified in its native environment [ Rivard et al., 2025 ] . The resulting 200 clips last 30 seconds each at 15 fps and 512 × 384 512\times 384 , yielding 89,800 transitions with frames and raw inputs but no element or state labels. The two cursor-speed modes are 2.5 and 190 pixels/frame, compared with the originally reported 1.5 and 195 at twice the resolution.
paragraphs.zh: NeuralOS 风格：由于原始数据不可用，我们在其原生环境中未经修改地运行了已发布的采集器 [Rivard et al., 2025]。 由此生成的 200 个片段，每个片段时长 30 秒，帧率为 15 fps，分辨率为 512 × 384 512\times 384，共包含 89,800 次过渡、帧和原始输入，但没有元素或状态标签。 两种光标速度模式分别为 2.5 和 190 像素/帧，而最初报告的值在两倍分辨率下为 1.5 和 195。

paragraphs.en: Blind in our environment (B1): a NeuralOS-style sampler chooses a random key with probability 0.10; otherwise, it clicks uniformly over the 640 × 480 640\times 480 screen, with single/double/right-click probabilities of 65/30/5%. Inputs are issued through xdotool in a fresh Nautilus container per trajectory; screenshots are captured with scrot after a 0.7-second settling period. We collect 24 trajectories of 300 actions (7,200 actions). Recovery and validity checking are disabled. Records contain screenshots, inputs, and the active-window registry.
paragraphs.zh: 环境中的盲目性（B1）：一个 NeuralOS 风格的采样器以 0.10 的概率随机选择一个键；否则，它在 640 × 480 的屏幕上均匀点击，其中单击、双击和右键点击的概率分别为 65%、30% 和 5%。 每个轨迹通过 xdotool 在一个新的 Nautilus 容器中发出输入；在 0.7 秒的稳定期之后，使用 scrot 捕获屏幕截图。 我们收集了 24 条包含 300 个动作的轨迹（共 7,200 个动作）。 恢复和有效性检查已禁用。 记录包含屏幕截图、输入以及当前活动窗口的注册表信息。

paragraphs.en: In the memory experiment of Section 4.3 , the target’s first visit occupies frames 7-9, with zero-based indexing. Frame 7 belongs to the ground-truth context, whereas frames 8-9 are generated. For self-consistency, we pair each of these two generated frames with each of the five target-revisit frames, producing 10 pairs per trajectory, 1,840 pairs per horizon, and 9,200 pairs overall. Both models are evaluated at 256 × 192 256\times 192 resolution using the same element-crop matching and SSIM procedures, yielding 12,510 crop comparisons per horizon with no skipped comparisons. Only the designated target is scored: revisits to ancestor folders encountered during distraction are excluded. This benchmark evaluates retention of unchanged content; it does not test memory updates following content mutations.

paragraphs.en: We compare generated target-revisit frames with their corresponding ground-truth frames using ROI-level SSIM. Figure 10 shows that StateCraft maintains SSIM of 0.92–0.94 across all horizons, whereas no baseline exceeds 0.51. Oracle retrieval remains close to base CF++ despite improving self-consistency, indicating that selecting the correct past latent under this cache mechanism does not by itself yield correct reconstruction. These results confirm that our high revisit consistency accompanies similarity to the target content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 ROI 级别的 SSIM 将生成的目标重访帧与其对应的真实参考帧进行比较。 图 10 显示，StateCraft 在所有时间步上都能保持 0.92–0.94 的 SSIM，而没有任何基线模型超过 0.51。 尽管自一致性得到了提升，但 Oracle 检索结果仍与基础 CF++ 接近，这表明在此缓存机制下，仅选择正确的过去潜在状态本身并不会产生正确的重建结果。 这些结果证实，我们的高重访一致性伴随着与目标内容的相似性。

paragraphs.en: We adapt Mixture of Contexts [ Cai et al., 2025 ] to the causal KV-cache implementation of our CF++ baseline, without graph conditioning. Historical keys are partitioned into one-frame chunks of 1,560 tokens. A parameter-free router scores chunks using dot products between pooled query and key representations. To accommodate the frame-autoregressive implementation, routing decisions are shared across the query tokens within each frame, rather than computed separately for each token. We set the chunk-selection parameter to 21 and retain the two most recent chunks as mandatory context. Text remains accessible through Wan’s cross-attention. During training, selected non-mandatory chunks undergo context drop-off and drop-in, using p max = 0.5 p_{\max}=0.5 and λ = 2 \lambda=2 , respectively (these values are implementation choices).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将“上下文混合”方法 [Cai et al., 2025] 适配到我们 CF++ 基线的因果 KV-cache 实现中，且无需图条件约束。 历史键被划分为每帧 1,560 个词元的单帧块。 一个无参数的路由器通过池化后的查询与键表示之间的点积对块进行评分。 为适应帧自回归实现，路由决策在每个帧内的所有查询词元之间共享，而非为每个词元单独计算。 我们将块选择参数设为 21，并保留最近两个块作为强制性上下文。 文本仍可通过 Wan 的交叉注意力机制访问。 在训练期间，选定的非强制性块会经历上下文移除与插入过程，分别使用 p max = 0.5 p_{\max}=0.5 和 λ = 2 \lambda=2（这些数值为实现中的可选参数）。

Training uses 76-latent-frame clips at 640 × 480 640\times 480 resolution and the base model’s consistency-distillation objective, with learning rate 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} , weight decay 0.01, and EMA decay 0.99.

Finetuning does not consistently improve these scores and progressively reduces visual sharpness. paragraphs.en: We augment CF++ with an episode-specific bank indexed by ground-truth folder identity, storing the first generated latent for each folder and excluding ground-truth context frames. On subsequent occurrences, the stored latent replaces the newly generated latent only when updating the context cache; output frames remain model-generated. Retrieval therefore influences subsequent frames, not the first frame of a revisit. Retrieved latents use the current temporal position, and all other generation settings match base CF++. This baseline removes state-matching errors through privileged identities unavailable at deployment, while retaining first-visit generation errors. It tests oracle selection under this cache mechanism, rather than an upper bound on retrieval-based generation generally.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个以真实文件夹身份为索引的、针对每个episode的专用存储库来增强CF++，该存储库保存每个文件夹首次生成的潜在变量，并排除真实上下文帧。 在后续出现时，已存储的潜在变量仅在更新上下文缓存时替换新生成的潜在变量；输出帧仍由模型生成。 因此，检索会影响后续帧，而不会影响重访时的第一帧。 检索到的潜在变量使用当前的时间位置，且所有其他生成设置均与基础CF++一致。 该基线通过部署时无法获取的特权身份消除了状态匹配错误，但保留了首次访问时的生成错误。 它测试的是在此缓存机制下的“神谕”选择效果，而非检索式生成的一般性上限。

paragraphs.zh: 在表 6 中，我们使用 DFoT 作为主干模型，扩展了第 4.2 节中呈现的评估。

paragraphs.en: The state-predictor module is scored here against the ground truth recorded on node accuracy (exact structural match of the next node), transition accuracy, schema validity, and generation speed in tokens per second. Table 7 shows the evaluation of two backbones for in-domain and out-of-domain tasks. The OOD tasks are either unseen scenarios following the same JSON structure (i.e. memory game, battleship, blackjack) and unseen operations (i.e. "delete all the files starting with the letter ’A’"). For this evaluation, we test the model on the graph states of the hold-out set for the consistency experiment (Section 4.2 ), and on a set of synthetic experiments for the OOD scenarios.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two reduced conditioning variants of DFoT while keeping the backbone, frozen encoder, cross-attention mechanism, and training budget fixed. Path embeds only the current filesystem path into one token per frame, providing state identity without contents. Flat-node embeds the entire serialized node, including its path and visible elements, into one token, retaining content without separate element representations. Both single-token variants retain the encoder’s native embedding width, whereas the full model truncates embeddings to accommodate multiple graph tokens. Both variants are finetuned from the same action-conditioned checkpoint using the full model’s warm-up and training schedule. Together with the unconditioned baseline and full model, they test the contributions of state identity, content, and elementwise access.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在保持骨干网络、冻结编码器、交叉注意力机制和训练预算不变的同时，评估了 DFoT 的两种简化条件变体。 Path 嵌入仅将当前文件系统的路径编码为每帧一个标记，从而提供状态身份而不包含内容。 Flat-node 将整个序列化的节点（包括其路径和可见元素）嵌入为一个标记，保留了内容而无需单独的元素表示。 这两种单标记变体都保留了编码器的原始嵌入宽度，而完整模型则对嵌入进行了截断以容纳多个图标记。 两种变体均使用完整模型的预热和训练计划，从相同的动作条件检查点开始进行微调。 它们与无条件基线模型和完整模型一起，用于测试状态身份、内容和逐元素访问的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 shows that path conditioning improves breadcrumb reconstruction but provides little benefit for canvas content or revisit consistency. Flat-node conditioning improves both, while separate graph tokens yield the strongest results: canvas SSIM increases from 0.62 without conditioning to 0.76 with flat-node conditioning and 0.92 with graph tokens. Within canvas text boxes, the corresponding scores are 0.20, 0.54, and 0.91. Graph tokens also improve canvas PSNR by ∼ \sim 7 dB over flat-node conditioning and maintain revisit scores of 0.89–0.93 across the evaluated distances. The unconditioned model retains a small advantage on full-region side-panel metrics, where appearance is identical across trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 表 8 显示，路径条件化能提升面包屑的重建效果，但对画布内容或重访一致性几乎没有帮助。 平节点条件化可同时提升这两项指标，而独立的图令牌则带来了最强的效果：在未经条件化的情况下，画布的 SSIM 为 0.62，使用平节点条件化后提升至 0.76，使用图令牌后则达到 0.92。 在画布文本框内，对应的分数分别为 0.20、0.54 和 0.91。 图令牌还将画布的 PSNR 相比平节点条件化提升了约 \sim 7 dB，并且在所有评估距离上均保持了 0.89–0.93 的重访分数。 在未条件化的模型中，全区域侧边栏指标仍保留轻微优势，因为外观在所有轨迹中完全相同。

paragraphs.en: We test whether the gains in Section 4.2 depend on graph conditioning beyond the ROI-weighted loss, and whether actions remain useful when the target state is supplied explicitly. For both DFoT and CF++, we independently zero the graph or action channel at inference, following the independent conditioning dropout used during training. Evaluating the same finetuned models holds the learned weights and training objective fixed while measuring their dependence on each signal (Table 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验了第 4.2 节中的增益是否依赖于 ROI 加权损失之外的图条件，以及在目标状态被明确提供时，动作是否仍然有用。 对于 DFoT 和 CF++，我们在推理阶段分别将图通道或动作通道置零，这遵循了训练期间使用的独立条件 dropout 方法。 评估相同的微调模型可以保持已学习的权重和训练目标不变，同时衡量它们对每种信号的依赖程度（表 9）。

paragraphs.en: Removing graph conditioning substantially degrades content reconstruction and memory: canvas SSIM falls by 0.333 for CF++ and 0.291 for DFoT, while revisit SSIM decreases by 0.222 and 0.210, respectively. These losses occur despite training with ROI reweighting, showing that the reweighted objective alone does not sustain the full model’s state fidelity when graph information is unavailable. This experiment establishes the model’s dependence on graph conditioning, although it does not separately quantify the contribution of loss reweighting.
paragraphs.zh: 移除图条件会显著降低内容重建和记忆效果：对于 CF++，画布 SSIM 下降了 0.333，DFoT 下降了 0.291；而对于重访 SSIM，则分别下降了 0.222 和 0.210。 尽管在训练时使用了 ROI 重新加权，这些损失仍然发生了，这表明仅靠重新加权的目标函数无法在图信息不可用时维持完整模型的状态保真度。 该实验证明了模型对图条件的依赖关系，尽管它并未单独量化损失重新加权的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Removing actions produces smaller reconstruction losses across both backbones, but its effect is not negligible: canvas SSIM decreases by 0.061 for CF++ and 0.051 for DFoT. Revisit consistency remains nearly unchanged for CF++ but drops by 0.092 for DFoT. Qualitative rollouts retain approximately correct target contents while exhibiting noisier, less plausible transitions, consistent with actions helping the model apply visual changes. Together, these results support complementary roles for the two channels: graph conditioning supplies explicit state contents, while actions improve their realization during interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 移除动作可在两种骨干网络中都产生更小的重建损失，但其影响不可忽略：对于 CF++，画布 SSIM 下降了 0.061；对于 DFoT，则下降了 0.051。 对于 CF++，一致性重审几乎保持不变，但对于 DFoT，则下降了 0.092。 定性展开结果保留了大致正确的目标内容，但过渡过程更嘈杂且可信度较低，这与动作有助于模型应用视觉变化的结论一致。 综合来看，这些结果支持了两种通道的互补作用：图条件提供了明确的状态内容，而动作则在交互过程中提升了这些内容的实现效果。

paragraphs.en: At a threshold calibrated for 99% skip purity, the held-out probe skips 41.0% of decisions with 99.0% purity, defined as the fraction of skips requiring no state change. In closed-loop evaluation without a verifier, it skips 3,914 of 9,600 decisions across 48 trajectories (40.8%), including 345 incorrect skips, giving 91.2% purity and 5,686 language-model calls. Incorrect skips retain stale states that can affect later decisions. Relative to generation without gating, PSNR decreases by 0.57 dB and SSIM by 0.008. These results establish call savings, not an end-to-end latency improvement.

paragraphs.en: We collect 8,644 training, 294 validation, and 828 test trajectories in OmniGibson interiors, with 14 houses represented in training and two unseen houses reserved for testing. The test set contains seven scene groups, each defined by a house and route setup. Trajectories vary camera paths, switch activations, and target-room visits. Each clip contains 81 video frames, encoded into 21 latent frames. The video model receives actions and simulator-derived room-category and illumination-state tokens through the abstract-state conditioning pathway. Room-identity tokens are omitted. State updates are supplied by the simulator in this experiment. Conditioning is aligned with the next generated frame and provided with an eight-frame lead, making the illumination signal available during the ground-truth context before the target room is revealed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 OmniGibson 室内环境中收集了 8,644 条训练轨迹、294 条验证轨迹和 828 条测试轨迹，其中训练集包含 14 栋房屋，而测试集则保留了 2 栋未见过的房屋。 测试集包含七个场景组，每个场景组都由一栋房屋和一条路线设置定义。 轨迹在相机路径、开关激活以及目标房间的访问方面各不相同。 每个片段包含 81 帧视频，被编码为 21 个潜在帧。 视频模型通过抽象状态条件通路接收动作以及由模拟器生成的房间类别和光照状态标记。 房间身份标记被省略了。 在本实验中，状态更新由模拟器提供。 条件信息与下一个生成的帧对齐，并提前八帧提供，这使得在目标房间揭示之前，光照信号就能在真实上下文阶段可用。

paragraphs.en: We adapt the CF++ backbone using conditioning warmup followed by joint training. The training objective upweights five reveal frames by a factor of 50 and includes a contrastive term that encourages sensitivity to the state signal. We select the checkpoint using the validation split and report results on the held-out test set; the selected checkpoint corresponds to 3,000 joint-training steps. The comparison model starts from the same warmup checkpoint and trains for 3,000 steps with the graph-conditioning pathway absent. Evaluation supplies 14 ground-truth latent frames and autoregressively generates the remaining seven.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用条件预热，随后进行联合训练来适配 CF++ 主干模型。 该训练目标将五个揭示帧的权重提升 50 倍，并包含一个对比项，以增强对状态信号的敏感性。 我们利用验证集选择检查点，并在预留的测试集上报告结果；所选的检查点对应于 3,000 步联合训练。 对比模型从相同的预热检查点开始，在没有图条件通道的情况下训练 3,000 步。 评估过程提供 14 个真实标签的潜在帧，并自回归地生成其余七个。
